```{r Airquality}
#|echo: false

data(airquality)

rows_with_na <- c()

for (i in 1:nrow(airquality)) {
  for (j in 1:ncol(airquality)) {
    if (is.na(airquality[i, j])) {
      rows_with_na <- c(rows_with_na, i)
      break   
    }
  }
}



min(airquality$Temp)
max(airquality$Temp)
sd(airquality$Temp)
mean(airquality$Temp)

min(na.omit(airquality$Ozone))
max(na.omit(airquality$Ozone))
sd(na.omit(airquality$Ozone))
mean(na.omit(airquality$Ozone))

```

```{r Cars}
#|echo: false

data(cars)

X <- model.matrix(dist ~ speed, data = cars)
Y <- as.matrix(cars$dist)

beta_hat <- solve(t(X) %*% X) %*% t(X) %*% Y
beta_hat

coef(lm(dist ~ speed, data = cars))

```
